recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-20421 unless a new tracker requests a current-release diff-page title change.
issue_request: FHIR-20421 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised for STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that diff.html's breadcrumb said "Foundation > Differences from DSTU Release 2" and requested a STU/Release 3 breadcrumb instead.
initial_application: No current-branch commit explicitly mentions FHIR-20421. Git history shows the relevant correction was applied implicitly: 3c3f93c3dae503d0598b2b5abfc927a3a8ea063f changed source/diff.html from DSTU Release 2 to Release 3, and 142ad7624ca77d81a9463a6ddbd278f521a109da changed source/hierarchy.xml's diff.html page title, which feeds breadcrumbs, from DSTU Release 2 to Release 3.
additional_context: FHIR-23809 independently listed the same diff-page navbar problem in a broader typo bundle and explains the 2021 hierarchy.xml hunk. Later, FHIR-38741 corrected the same page family from Release 3 to Release 4 for R5 and is already represented on the combined branch. Current R6 source now labels diff.html as "Differences from Release 4/5" with version-specific R4/R4B/R5-to-R6 pages.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/diff.html, source/hierarchy.xml, publish.ini, and the rendered CI build all show that the active diff.html breadcrumb/title is no longer the stale DSTU Release 2 wording; changing it to STU Release 3 now would be wrong for the current R6 page scope.
